faq.q: What does Applied Structural Drying — Core Concepts cover?
faq.a: Builds on water restoration fundamentals with a focus on structural drying, documentation rigour, and complex assemblies.

faq.q: Which syllabus topics are listed for Applied Structural Drying — Core Concepts?
faq.a: Syllabus topics include Module 2 — Vapour pressure & drying forces; Module 3 — Cavities & concealed assemblies; Module 4 — Supplemental heat & conditioning; Module 5 — Hardwood & engineered flooring; Module 6 — Concrete & lightweight slab systems; Module 7 — Monitoring plans & KPIs.
